title: 第005章 突破第006章 海祸
lines: 《盘龙桩》属于中乘功法，也是雕龙功的根基所在。
入门、小成、大成、圆满四个阶段，前二对应搬血，后二对应煅骨。
特点是打熬体魄，根基稳固。
像陈孤舟曾修行过的搬血劲，则是一门烂大街的下乘功法。
特点是通俗易懂，大家都能学。
至于缺点。
等他后来修行同样烂大街的‘磨盘功’，便体现了出来。
二者完全不是一个路子，所炼气血如脱缰野马。导致他准备煅骨时，难度提高了十倍不止。
最重要的是。
《盘龙桩》《戏珠手》二者合一，是上乘功法，有望突破通脉境。
戏珠手是一门技法，一共十八式。
修行之初需以开水烧烫铁珠，双手分而‘戏’之，直至运指如飞，不觉烫手。然后二珠、三珠、四珠……
其间需辅以功法中附带的药方，使药力渗透皮肉，在铁珠的刺激下增进双手韧性、灵活。
从九珠开始。
以滚油烧烫铁珠，直至双手同飞十八枚铁珠，方可功法圆满。
“这是奠基功法？难度有点变态了。”
稍作尝试之后。
陈孤舟有了一个清晰认知。
如果没有巧手词条，这门功法的难度，他一定是练不成的。
“不过——”陈孤舟手指一顿，“雕龙刀的兵法，在哪呢？”
想了一瞬。
他便会过意来。
自己如今不过一个‘小学生’，老师又怎么会把‘大学课程’摆到面前。
想学核心功法，最低要求也得通脉。
估计还要经过雕龙一脉的掌舵人周雕龙考验。
一个月后。
果然如赵志才所言，陈孤舟的巧手词条再显潜力，戏珠手顺利踏入‘七珠’。七枚烧开的铁珠在十指翻飞，缕缕白烟升起，丝毫不觉滚烫。
赵志才赞不绝口，陈孤舟也觉十分满意。
当练习到九珠时。
在功法锻炼与药膏双重刺激下，巧手词条潜力突破极限——按赵志才的说法，便是觉醒了武道根骨。
陈孤舟清晰感觉到，双掌血肉筋膜逐渐滋生一缕薄薄的气血。
灵动自如，控制随心。
搬血！
他终于重新踏入修行门槛。
这一缕气血，虽不如肌魁词条带来的浑厚，甚至相差千里，但胜在控制自如。
而这。
正代表了突破煅骨的潜力！
随后，陈孤舟开始正式修行盘龙桩。
盘龙桩同样有十八式，练的是整体肌肉、筋骨。
结合戏珠手对身体的细微控制，不断打熬全身每一丝肌肉，辅助一副三两银子的药膳‘龟蛇茯草汤’。
每日食补滋养肉身，再运功转化。
content_en:
"Coiling Dragon Stake" belongs to the middle vehicle method and is also the foundation of Dragon Carving Kung Fu.
There are four stages: entry, small success, great success, and consummation. The first two correspond to moving blood, and the last two correspond to forging bones.
It is characterized by strengthening the body and building a solid foundation.
For example, Chen Guzhou once practiced the blood-moving power, which is a poor and inferior skill.
The characteristic is that it is easy to understand and everyone can learn it.
As for the shortcomings.
This became apparent when he later practiced the equally bad "Mopan Gong".
The two are completely different approaches, and the qi and blood refined are like wild horses running wild. As a result, when he was preparing to burn the bones, the difficulty increased more than ten times.
The most important thing is.
"Pailing Dragon Stake" and "Bead Playing Hand" are combined into one, which is an excellent technique that is expected to break through the realm of meridians.
The bead-playing technique is a technique with a total of eighteen movements.
At the beginning of the practice, you need to boil the iron beads in boiling water, spread your hands and 'play' with them until you move your fingers like flying and you don't feel hot. Then two beads, three beads, four beads...
It needs to be supplemented with the medicine included in the exercise, so that the medicine can penetrate the skin and flesh, and the toughness and flexibility of the hands can be improved under the stimulation of the iron beads.
Start with nine beads.
Heat iron balls with boiling oil until eighteen iron balls fly together with both hands, then the skill can be completed.
"Is this a foundational technique? The difficulty is a bit abnormal."
After trying it for a while.
Chen Guzhou had a clear understanding.
Without the Skillful Hands entry, he would definitely not be able to master the difficulty of this skill.
"But -" Chen Guzhou paused with his finger, "Where is the art of war with the Dragon Carving Sword?"
I thought for a moment.
He will feel better.
I am just a "primary school student" now, so why would the teacher put "university courses" in front of me.
If you want to learn the core skills, the minimum requirement is to open the meridians.
It is estimated that it will still have to be tested by Zhou Diaolong, the helmsman of the Diaolong lineage.
One month later.
Sure enough, as Zhao Zhicai said, Chen Guzhou's skillful entry once again showed his potential, and the bead player successfully entered the "Seven Beads". Seven boiling iron beads flew around his fingers, and wisps of white smoke rose, not feeling hot at all.
Zhao Zhicai was full of praise, and Chen Guzhou was also very satisfied.
When practicing to nine beads.
Under the dual stimulation of skill training and ointment, the potential of skillful hands has exceeded the limit-according to Zhao Zhicai, it is the awakening of martial arts roots.
Chen Guzhou clearly felt that a thin stream of qi and blood was gradually growing in the flesh and blood fascia of his palms.
Flexible and flexible, control as you wish.
Move blood!
He finally stepped onto the threshold of spiritual practice again.
Although this ray of energy and blood is not as rich as the Jikui entry, it is even thousands of miles away, but it is better than being able to control it.
And this.
It represents the potential to break through the bones!
Subsequently, Chen Guzhou began to formally practice Panlong Zhuang.
Panlong Zhuang also has eighteen postures, which train the overall muscles, muscles and bones.
Combined with the subtle control of the body by the bead-playing hand, it continuously exercises every muscle in the body, and assists with a medicinal diet of three taels of silver, 'Guishen Poria Soup'.
Daily supplements are taken to nourish the physical body, and then the energy is transformed.
